item.name: Database Restore
item.description: Please fill in the information below to request a restore of a database. Please be aware that restores of a production instance will require additional approvals.

variables.name: backup_source
variables.question: Restore from this source
variables.help_text: Specify the database from which you wish to restore. The default is to restore a database from its own backups, but you can specify a different database to be your restore source as well. This allows you to replace one database with a recent backup of another, which is often useful for setting up test systems.

variables.name: restore_pit
variables.question: Restore from this point in time
variables.help_text: Indicate which point in time you wish to restore from. Default (if you leave this blank) is to restore from the most recent available backup. However, it is possible to restore from an earlier point in time if necessary.
